title: initiative-dependency-visualizer-and-quarterly-synthesis
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create an interactive Initiative Dependency Visualizer and Quarterly Synthesis flow that surfaces company-level OKR alignment across teams. The tool will automatically ingest initiative metadata (owner, milestones, capacity windows, risks) and produce a condensed synthesis for exec review. Goals: reduce manual cross-team alignment work, surface critical-path dependencies early, and provide a repeatable artifact for quarterly planning. This ticket covers the initial MVP: weekly snapshot ingestion, a web UI for filtering by OKR and owner, dependency graph with impact flags, and an exportable one-page synthesis PDF for leadership sync.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Weekly ETL pulls initiative metadata from Linear + dedicated CSV import and shows on the visualizer; 2) Graph shows dependencies with prioritization lanes and risk flags; 3) One-click synthesis export contains OKR mapping, top 5 risks, owners, and recommended mitigation actions; 4) Owners can annotate dependencies and mark blockers; 5) Demo to Execs with sample of three cross-functional initiatives and receive sign-off.
success_metrics: Reduce time spent in cross-team alignment meetings by 30% (baseline: average 4 hours/week across PM/Eng leads)
Surface 90% of P1 dependencies before roadmap freeze (measured in two quarters)
Adoption by 80% of initiative owners for weekly annotations within quarter after launch
deliverables: ETL job and data schema for initiative snapshots
Visualizer web UI (filter/search, graph, owners view)
technical_notes: Opt for weekly snapshot ingestion using an ETL job to keep initial scope small; real-time sync is deferred due to API rate limits and schema churn. Data model will include: initiative_id, title, owner, okr_tags, start/end, milestones (list as CSV field), dependencies (list of initiative_ids), risk_level, capacity_window, last_updated. Store snapshots in a dedicated S3 bucket and expose via a lightweight API for the UI. Security: read-only tokens for Linear; ensure PII-free exports. Known trade-off: weekly snapshots may miss short-lived blockers but allow faster iteration and simpler rollback.
ux_notes: Primary view: a collapsible dependency graph with swimlanes for OKR pillars; secondary view: owner-focused timeline. Emphasize scannability: color-coded risk badges, compact owner chips, and a top-of-page synthesis bar summarizing total initiatives, open blockers, and capacity pressure. Figma frames drafted (link below) to guide implementation. Accessibility: keyboard navigation and color contrast for badges.
